verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents managed, centrally stored credentials: one-click OAuth and key-based auth for 3,000+ APIs, platform-handled token storage and refresh, and connected accounts kept separate between development and production environments. Nothing in the pack shows sharing credentials with teammates or per-credential access control, so only the central-storage part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: team sharing of connected accounts, role- or user-level permissions controlling who can use which credential, and independent or hands-on corroboration of credential governance.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential

citations.quote: One-click OAuth and key-based authentication for more than 3,000 APIs (use tokens directly in code or with pre-built actions)
you don't need to build any authorization flows or deal with token storage and refresh
Connected accounts and credentials stored in one environment remain separate from the other
